long_biography.plain_text:
Joseph 'Joe' Simone entered business alongside his father, Pat, first modernising Hunts Point Auto Parts through organised dismantling, computerised inventory and regional delivery. LKQ acquired the auto-parts operation in 1999. Simone then concentrated on the real-estate portfolio Pat had begun building in the Bronx and lower Westchester, expanding it into a multigenerational development company.

Simone is president of Simone Development Companies, which acquires, develops and manages healthcare, mixed-use, office, industrial, retail and residential properties across metropolitan New York, Connecticut and New Jersey. His role combines inherited family ownership with decades of operating expansion. The company's properties and project values belong to the family enterprise and are not treated as his personal assets.
